label: Chemical Consolidation Kit
description: Used to create archival-grade adhesives by mixing resin beads with volatile solvents at specific weight/volume ratios.

components.function: Transferring small, precise amounts of solvent (Acetone) to the mixing beaker.
Weighing resin beads (Paraloid B-72 or Butvar B-76) for the mixture.

components.safety_note: Solvents will evaporate quickly if lids are not seated correctly.

game_mechanics.viscosity_puzzle: Player must mix a thin solution (low beads/high solvent) for 'wicking' into tiny cracks, or thick solution for 'joining' large fragments.
game_mechanics.evaporation_timer: If the jar is left open too long, the 'glue' hardens and becomes unusable.
